profile_text.body:
Datadog, Inc. is a public company headquartered in New York, NY, and trades under the ticker DDOG. It is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001561550. Its website presents cloud monitoring as a service, describing a way to see metrics from apps, tools, and services in one place, with a free trial offered.

The site also addresses security, describing integration of security and observability to help organizations decode runtime execution, reduce exposure in dynamic AI environments, and carry out detection and response at what the company calls agentic speed against AI-powered attacks. No specific products are tracked in the record, and no lawsuits or MCP servers are listed.

The record notes litigation exposure in New York, with a count of 459.
